en.answer: The effect of a <<12015>> in the Graveyard is of Spell Speed 2. Therefore, it can be activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of other cards.
en.question: Can the effect of <<12015>> in the Graveyard be activated in a chain to the activation of the effects of other cards?
